title: UART, I2C, and SPI: choosing a bus

spans.text: UART is asynchronous point-to-point serial using TX/RX and common ground; baud rates must match. I2C shares SDA/SCL and addresses among devices and needs pull-ups. SPI uses SCK/MOSI/MISO plus a CS line per device for fast full-duplex transfer.

spans.caption: UART, I2C, and SPI: choosing a bus

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Cable length, speed, logic levels, and available pins matter. Check level compatibility before wiring a 5 V sensor directly to a 3.3 V ESP32.
